text.content: Grammar 2 Present continuous for future plans
Is Zack watching the game on Sunday?
No, he's not./ No, he isn't.
She's having a soccer partythis week.
Are they watching the game on Sunday?
No, they're not. / No, they aren't.
What else are you recording on Friday?
They're playing the Lions this weekend.
A Complete these conversations with the present continuous form of the verbs.
you___________ (do) on Friday? Do you want to come over?
B I'd love to, but I can't. Joe andl.
B What are you doing this weekend? Use these verbs to write about your
weekend plans. Then tell your partner.
Listen and repeat. Notice how the important words in a sentence are stressed.
I'm going to Colombia on Monday.
I’m going to Colombia on Monday. She’s staying home this weekend.

going and make a list of five shows you are recording.
